title: Rejected Dialects: Biases Against African American Language in Reward Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing reward model accuracy, raw preference scores, and conversational steering behavior on paired texts written in White Mainstream English (WME) versus African American Language (AAL), using both machine-translated and human-written datasets.

Evaluating raciolinguistic biases by measuring how reward models systemically disprefer and assign lower scores to AAL-aligned texts compared to WME texts, assessing representational harms against Black speakers.
